user_requirement: Turn on a relay when my room gets hotter than 30 degrees, using a DHT22 sensor on an ESP32.
effective_requirement: Poll a DHT22 sensor on GPIO 4 every 2 seconds. If the temperature climbs above 30 C, switch the relay on GPIO 5 ON; otherwise switch it OFF. Print the readings and the relay state via the serial terminal.

components.name: DHT22 temperature/humidity sensor
components.notes: 10k pull-up between DATA and 3V3; call measure() before temperature()/humidity()
